## Meso 0.2.5 Beta
This is a beta of the new Meso, rebuilt from the ground up, on its way to 0.3.0. It has had far less testing than 0.2.4: install it only if you're happy to report what breaks. For now it runs on Macs with Apple silicon only.
**Coming from 0.2.4** - The first time it opens, Meso brings over your settings, devices, buttons, keys, gestures and sequences, Time, usage statistics, Kindle export records and AI keys. - Everything 0.2.4 wrote is kept untouched in `~/Library/Application Support/Meso/Backups/Meso 0.2`. To go back, install 0.2.4 again and move those files back. - Not brought over: recipes, the menu bar layout, the downloader's list of past jobs, and a few actions the new Meso doesn't have yet.
**Updates** - This build follows the Beta channel and updates itself to later betas.
